sentences.text:
Mamoni Bhadra (Das) vs Bablu Bhadra on 21 March, 2023
279 21.3.2023
 Sc Ct. no.652
 C.O. 800 Of 2023
 --------------
Mamoni Bhadra (Das) Vs. Bablu Bhadra Ms. Rupsa Sreemani Ms. Piya Sarkar.

...  For the Petitioner This is an application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Matrimonial Suit No.2843 of 2022 pending in the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Barasat to the court of Learned Additional District Judge, Kalyani, Nadia.
The petitioner contended that the petitioner was married with the opposite party according to the Hindu rites and customs on 18th November 2018.
The petitioner alleged that ever since marriage she was subjected to physical and mental torture by her husband and in-laws during her stay at matrimonial house on various pretext.
The parties are blessed with a male child and the child is staying with the petitioner.

The petitioner lodged a criminal complaint against the opposite party and his family members under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code which is now pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kalyani, Nadia.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kalyani, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a counter-blast, the opposite party has filed the present suit seeking dissolution of marriage, which is now pending in the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court at Barasat.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, 1st Court at Barasat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner submits that she is a house-wife having no source of income and she has to lookafter her minor child and she is facing lot of inconveniences in attending such proceeding at Barasat from her present residence.

She further submits that she has also initiated proceeding under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which is now pending in the court at Kalyani where the opposite party would be required to attend.
Moreover, the court at Barasat situates at the distance of 53 Kilometers from her present place of residence and there is none to escort her on her way to Barasat Court.
Accordingly, she has sought for aforesaid transfer.

The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application to the opposite party through speed post with acknowledgement due within a period of ten days intimating the next date of hearing and file affidavit- of-service on the date fixed.
Let the matter appear under the heading "Hearing of Section 24 Application" on 25th April, 2023.

Since the petitioner has made out an arguable case, let all further proceedings of Matrimonial Suit No.2843 of 2022 pending before the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Barasat,
North 24-Parganas is stayed for a period of eight weeks or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

(Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
